description: This file contains utility functions for rendering XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, including functions for wrapping text, handling list items, and escaping special characters. It is part of a documentation processing module within a larger project.

methods.name: renderXmlDoc
methods.description: Main function to render XML documentation from Markdown nodes, producing an array of strings with a specified prefix.

methods.name: _innerRenderNodes
methods.description: Internal function to process Markdown nodes into summary and remarks sections, handling list items and special node types.

methods.name: _wrapCode
methods.description: Escapes special characters in code lines and formats them for XML inclusion.

methods.name: _wrapInNode
methods.description: Wraps given nodes in specified XML tags and appends to target array.

methods.name: _wrapAndEscape
methods.description: Processes a Markdown node's text, escaping special characters, converting links, and splitting into lines respecting max column width.

methods.name: _nodeShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a Markdown node should be ignored based on its content.

methods.name: renderTextOnly
methods.description: Renders only the textual summary from Markdown nodes, ignoring other node types.
